source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 27 (PDF 160-177), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 27 (Biochemistry) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Biochemistry is the branch of science that deals with:
(Biochemistry science ki woh shaakh hai jo kis ka mutaala karti hai?)

options.text: zinda organisms ke chemical substances aur un ke reactions
sirf chattanon aur mitti ki minerals

blocks.explanation: Biochemistry zinda organisms mein paye jane wale chemical substances aur un ke reactions ka mutaala hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Biochemistry is the branch of science that deals with the study of chemical substances found in living organisms

blocks.prompt:
2 The biological compounds contain functional groups that are:
(Biological compounds mein maujood functional groups kaise hote hain?)

options.text: sirf zinda cells mein, saade organic compounds mein kabhi nahi
sirf inorganic ions jaise Na⁺ aur Cl⁻
wahi jo saade organic compounds mein hote hain

blocks.explanation: Biological compounds complex molecules hain magar un mein wahi functional groups hain jo saade organic compounds mein hote hain: alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester aur amide (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: same types of functional groups those found in simple organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is NOT one of the essential biomolecules studied in this chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa is chapter ke zaroori biomolecules mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Zaroori biomolecules carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids hain; polythene aik synthetic polymer hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: This chapter focuses on the essential biomolecules such as carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids

blocks.prompt:
4 Chemically, carbohydrates are:
(Chemical lehaaz se carbohydrates kya hain?)

options.text: fatty acids aur glycerol ke esters
polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones ya un se bane compounds

blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones ya un se bane compounds hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: Chemically, they are polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones or their derived compounds.

blocks.prompt:
5 Besides sugars, starch and cellulose, carbohydrates include substances found in:
(Sugars, starch aur cellulose ke ilawa carbohydrates mein kahan paye jane wale substances bhi shamil hain?)

options.text: haddiyon aur daanton mein calcium salts
bacteria ki cell walls aur insects ke exoskeletons

blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates mein sugars, starch, cellulose aur bacteria ki cell walls aur insects ke exoskeletons (bahar ka sakht dhancha) ke substances shamil hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: substances found in bacterial cell walls and insect exoskeletons

blocks.prompt:
6 The simplest carbohydrates which cannot be hydrolysed further into simpler compounds are:
(Sab se saade carbohydrates jo mazeed saade compounds mein hydrolyse nahi ho sakte, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Monosaccharides sab se saade carbohydrates hain; yeh mazeed hydrolyse nahi hote (27.1).

book_ref.quote: They cannot be hydrolysed further into simpler compounds.

blocks.prompt:
7 In the general formula of monosaccharides, Cₙ(H₂O)y, n ranges from:
(Monosaccharides ke general formula Cₙ(H₂O)y mein n ki range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monosaccharides ka general formula Cₙ(H₂O)y hai jahan n teen se saat tak hota hai (27.1).

book_ref.quote: where n ranges from three to seven

blocks.prompt:
8 A monosaccharide containing five carbon atoms is called a:
(Paanch carbon atoms wala monosaccharide kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Triose 3 C, tetrose 4 C, pentose 5 C, hexose 6 C (27.1).

book_ref.quote: a pentose has five carbons, and a hexose contains six carbons

blocks.prompt:
9 Fructose is classified as a:
(Fructose ko kis qisam mein rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose mein aldehydic group hai (aldose); fructose mein ketonic group hai (ketose) (27.1).

book_ref.quote: Glucose is an aldose whereas fructose is a ketose.

blocks.prompt:
10 Which pair consists of monosaccharides only?
(Kis jode mein sirf monosaccharides hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose aur fructose monosaccharides hain; sucrose disaccharide hai (27.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Examples of monosaccharides are glucose and fructose.

blocks.prompt:
11 Pentoses and hexoses are more stable and more abundant as:
(Pentoses aur hexoses kis shakal mein ziyada mustahkam aur ziyada maujood hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch ya chhe carbon wali sugars open chain ke muqable mein ring (cyclic) shakal mein ziyada mustahkam hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: are more stable and hence more abundant as cyclic structures than as open chain structures

blocks.prompt:
12 The five-membered ring formed by fructose is known as:
(Fructose jo paanch members wala ring banata hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fructose paanch members wala furanose ring banata hai; glucose chhe members wala pyranose ring (27.1).

book_ref.quote: fructose forms a five-membered ring known as furanose

blocks.prompt:
13 The ring of glucose is:
(Glucose ka ring kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose ka ring chhe members wala hai jise pyranose kehte hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: whereas glucose has a six-membered ring known as pyranose

blocks.prompt:
14 In aqueous solution, glucose molecules exist mostly as:
(Paani ke solution mein glucose ke molecules ziyada tar kis shakal mein hote hain?)

options.text: solid mein ring magar solution mein sirf open chain
rings, bohat thodi open-chain shakal ke saath equilibrium mein

blocks.explanation: Book correction: solution mein bhi ziyada tar monosaccharide molecules ring hain, jo bohat thodi open-chain shakal (glucose ke liye 1% se bohat kam) ke saath equilibrium (tawazun) mein hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: In solution, too, most monosaccharide molecules are rings

blocks.prompt:
15 Pure monosaccharides are solids because of:
(Khalis monosaccharides solid kyun hote hain?)

options.text: un ke bohat se –OH groups ki ziyada hydrogen bonding

blocks.explanation: Bohat se –OH groups molecules ke darmiyan ziyada hydrogen bonding karte hain, is liye monosaccharides solid hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: results in the extensive hydrogen bonding between their molecules

blocks.prompt:
16 Monosaccharides are highly soluble in water because they:
(Monosaccharides paani mein bohat hal kyun hote hain?)

options.text: poori tarah ions mein toot jate hain
paani ke molecules se ziyada hydrogen bonds banate hain

blocks.explanation: Solution mein monosaccharides paani ke molecules ke saath ziyada hydrogen bonds banate hain (27.1).

book_ref.quote: they form extensive hydrogen bonding with water molecules, making them highly soluble in water

blocks.prompt:
17 Which sugar is called blood sugar?
(Kaun si sugar blood sugar kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose insani khoon mein maujood hone ki wajah se blood sugar kehlati hai (27.1).

book_ref.quote: Glucose is called blood sugar due to its presence in the human blood

blocks.prompt:
18 The thickness and viscosity of honey are due to:
(Shehad ka gaarha pan aur viscosity (gaarhapan) kis wajah se hai?)

options.text: glucose aur fructose ki mazboot hydrogen bonding

blocks.explanation: Shehad mein glucose aur fructose ziyada hain; un ki mazboot hydrogen bonding shehad ko gaarha banati hai (27.1).

book_ref.quote: The thickness and viscosity of honey is due to their strong and intensive hydrogen bonding.

blocks.prompt:
19 The general formula of the common disaccharides is:
(Aam disaccharides ka general formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Disaccharides ka aam formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ hai (Disaccharides).

book_ref.quote: generally with the formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁

blocks.prompt:
20 The C–O–C bond joining two monosaccharide units is called the:
(Do monosaccharide units ko jodne wala C–O–C bond kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do monosaccharides glycosidic linkage, yani C–O–C bond, se jude hote hain (Disaccharides).

book_ref.quote: The bond C–O–C is known as the glycosidic bond.

blocks.prompt:
21 When two monosaccharides join to form a disaccharide by condensation, the molecule released is:
(Jab do monosaccharides condensation se disaccharide banate hain to kaun sa molecule nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Condensation reaction mein paani ka aik molecule kharij hota hai (Disaccharides).

book_ref.quote: releasing a molecule of water

blocks.prompt:
22 Sucrose (table sugar) is a disaccharide made of:
(Sucrose (cheeni) kin do units se bana disaccharide hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sucrose, aam cheeni, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai (Disaccharides).

book_ref.quote: is a disaccharide of glucose and fructose

blocks.prompt:
23 Which of the following is NOT one of the common disaccharides?
(In mein se kaun sa aam disaccharides mein se NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Sucrose, lactose aur maltose aam disaccharides hain; starch polysaccharide hai (Disaccharides).

book_ref.quote: Among the most common disaccharides are sucrose, lactose and maltose.

blocks.prompt:
24 Taking C = 12, H = 1 and O = 16, the molar mass of a disaccharide C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ is:
(C = 12, H = 1 aur O = 16 le kar disaccharide C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ ka molar mass kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: M = 12(12) + 22(1) + 11(16) = 144 + 22 + 176 = 342 g mol⁻¹ (yani 2 × 180 – 18, kyun ke paani nikal jata hai).

book_ref.quote: Disaccharides consist of two monosaccharide units joined together via glycosidic linkage

blocks.prompt:
25 The general molecular formula of polysaccharides is:
(Polysaccharides ka general molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polysaccharides ka molecular mass ziyada hai aur general formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: having general molecular formula, (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ

blocks.prompt:
26 On hydrolysis, polysaccharides give:
(Hydrolysis par polysaccharides kya dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polysaccharides hydrolysis par saadi sugars (monosaccharides) dete hain (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: Polysaccharides give simple sugars, i.e., monosaccharides on hydrolysis.

blocks.prompt:
27 The main storage form of energy in plants is:
(Paudon mein energy ka bara zakheera kis shakal mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Starch paudon mein energy ka bara zakheera hai aur glucose units se bana hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: Starch is the main storage of energy in plants

blocks.prompt:
28 The two components of starch are:
(Starch ke do hisse kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Starch ke do hisse amylose aur amylopectin hain (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: It has two components, amylose and amylopectin.

blocks.prompt:
29 The structure of amylose consists of:
(Amylose ki banawat kaisi hai?)

options.text: lambi, be-shaakh chains jin mein bohat glycosidic linkages hain

blocks.explanation: Amylose ki lambi be-shaakh chains hain; amylopectin compact aur bohat shaakhon wala hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: Amylose has a long, unbranched chains with many glycosidic linkages.

blocks.prompt:
30 The major structural material of plant cell walls is:
(Paudon ki cell walls ka bara structural maadda kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka bara structural maadda hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: Cellulose is the major structural material found in plant cell walls.

blocks.prompt:
31 Cellulose is rigid and insoluble in water because its chains:
(Cellulose sakht aur paani mein na-hal kyun hai?)

options.text: aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain

blocks.explanation: Cellulose ki lambi be-shaakh chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: These chains form strong hydrogen bonds with each other, making cellulose rigid and insoluble in water.

blocks.prompt:
32 In human food, cellulose is important as:
(Insani khurak mein cellulose kis shakal mein ahem hai?)

options.text: fibre, jo aanton ki sehat behtar karta hai
fat mein hal hone wala vitamin

blocks.explanation: Cellulose insani khurak mein fibre ki shakal mein ahem hai jo aanton ki sehat behtar karta hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: It is very important in human food in the form of fibre

blocks.prompt:
33 'Animal starch' is the name given to:
('Animal starch' kis ka naam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycogen, glucose ka polymer jo janwaron mein jama hota hai, animal starch kehlata hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: It is also called the 'animal starch'.

blocks.prompt:
34 In animals, glycogen is stored mainly in the:
(Janwaron mein glycogen ziyada tar kahan jama hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycogen janwaron ke jigar (liver) aur muscles mein jama hota hai (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: that is stored in the liver and muscles of animals

blocks.prompt:
35 Compared with amylopectin, glycogen is:
(Amylopectin ke muqable mein glycogen kaisa hai?)

options.text: banawat mein milta julta magar ziyada shaakhon wala

blocks.explanation: Glycogen ki banawat amylopectin jaisi hai magar is mein shaakhen aur ziyada hain (Polysaccharides).

book_ref.quote: but it is more highly branched, making it different from starch

blocks.prompt:
36 A sample of polysaccharide (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ has molar mass 48 600 g mol⁻¹. Taking C = 12, H = 1, O = 16, the value of n is:
(Aik polysaccharide (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ ka molar mass 48 600 g mol⁻¹ hai. C = 12, H = 1, O = 16 le kar n ki value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik unit C₆H₁₀O₅ = 72 + 10 + 80 = 162 g mol⁻¹; n = 48 600 ÷ 162 = 300. (270 ghalti se 180 lene par aata hai.)

book_ref.quote: Polysaccharides are large molecules consisting of a large number of monosaccharide units joined together.

blocks.prompt:
37 Which of the following is a polysaccharide?
(In mein se kaun sa polysaccharide hai?)
blocks.explanation: Starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin aam polysaccharides hain; lactose aur maltose disaccharides, fructose monosaccharide hai.

book_ref.quote: Common examples are starch, glycogen, cellulose and pectin.

blocks.prompt:
38 On metabolism, 1 g of glucose provides about:
(Metabolism mein 1 g glucose taqreeban kitni energy deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose aasani se jazb aur metabolise hota hai; 1 g taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: with 1 g of glucose providing about 15.6 kJ

blocks.prompt:
39 If 1 g of glucose provides about 15.6 kJ, the energy released from 25 g of glucose is about:
(Agar 1 g glucose taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai to 25 g glucose se kitni energy milegi?)
blocks.explanation: Energy = 25 g × 15.6 kJ g⁻¹ = 390 kJ.

book_ref.quote: They are easily absorbed and metabolized to release energy

blocks.prompt:
40 The normal range of blood glucose is:
(Khoon mein glucose ki normal range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam tor par blood glucose 70-110 mg/dL hota hai aur din mein thoda oopar neeche hota hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Normally, blood glucose levels range between 70-110 mg/dL

blocks.prompt:
41 Blood glucose levels are controlled by the hormones:
(Blood glucose ki miqdaar kin hormones se control hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insulin aur glucagon blood glucose ko control karte hain (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: These levels are controlled by the hormones insulin and glucagon.

blocks.prompt:
42 Excess glucose in the body is stored as:
(Jism mein zaaid glucose kis shakal mein jama hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zaaid glucose liver aur muscles mein glycogen ban kar jama hota hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Excess glucose is stored as glycogen in the liver and muscles.

blocks.prompt:
43 Hyperglycemia means:
(Hyperglycemia ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be-qaabu diabetes hyperglycemia (khoon mein ziyada sugar) paida kar sakti hai jo nerves aur blood vessels ko nuqsan deti hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Uncontrolled diabetes can cause hyperglycemia (high blood sugar)

blocks.prompt:
44 Diabetes occurs when:
(Diabetes kab hoti hai?)

options.text: liver bohat ziyada glycogen banata hai
jism bohat kam fructose jazb karta hai
gurde zaaid fat jama karte hain
pancreas kaafi insulin nahi banata ya jism use theek istemal nahi karta

blocks.explanation: Diabetes aik daaimi (chronic) haalat hai jab pancreas kaafi insulin nahi banata ya jism use theek istemal nahi kar pata (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: when the pancreas does not produce enough insulin

blocks.prompt:
45 Insufficient carbohydrate intake can result in:
(Carbohydrates kam khane ka nateeja kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: thakawat aur jismani o zehni karkardagi mein kami

blocks.explanation: Kam carbohydrates thakawat aur jismani aur zehni karkardagi mein kami la sakte hain (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: insufficient carbohydrate intake can result in fatigue

blocks.prompt:
46 High intake of fructose causes:
(Fructose ziyada khane se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fructose energy deta hai magar ziyada khane se motapa (obesity) yani fat ka ziyada jama hona hota hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Its high intake causes obesity

blocks.prompt:
47 When the body has sufficient carbohydrates for its energy needs, it:
(Jab jism ke paas energy ke liye kaafi carbohydrates hon to woh kya karta hai?)

options.text: insulin banana band kar deta hai
inhein minerals mein badal deta hai
proteins ya fats todne ke bajaye inhi ko istemal karta hai

blocks.explanation: Kaafi carbohydrates hon to jism proteins ya fats todne ke bajaye inhi ko fuel banata hai (27.1.1).

book_ref.quote: it utilizes these instead of breaking down proteins or fats for fuel

blocks.prompt:
48 Complete hydrolysis of proteins gives:
(Proteins ki mukammal hydrolysis se kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins mukammal hydrolyse hon to amino acids dete hain (27.2).

book_ref.quote: When proteins are completely hydrolysed, they yield amino acids.

blocks.prompt:
49 About how many different amino acids link together in various sequences to make proteins?
(Taqreeban kitne mukhtalif amino acids mukhtalif tarteeb mein jud kar proteins banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 20 mukhtalif amino acids bohat qisam ke proteins banate hain (27.2).

book_ref.quote: About 20 different amino acids link together in various sequences

blocks.prompt:
50 Which of the following is a protein?
(In mein se kaun sa protein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jild, baal, haemoglobin (khoon ka laal pigment) aur muscles sab proteins hain (27.2).

book_ref.quote: haemoglobin in blood (red pigment)

blocks.prompt:
51 A peptide bond is a type of:
(Peptide bond kis qisam ka bond hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peptide bond do amino acids ke darmiyan amide bond hai (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: A peptide bond is an amide bond

blocks.prompt:
52 A peptide bond forms when the –COO⁻ group of one amino acid reacts with which group of the next amino acid?
(Peptide bond tab banta hai jab aik amino acid ka –COO⁻ group agle amino acid ke kis group se react kare?)
blocks.explanation: –COO⁻ group protonated amino group –NH₃⁺ se react karta hai (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: reacts with the -NH₃⁺ group of the adjacent amino acid

blocks.prompt:
53 Long chains of amino acids formed by many peptide linkages are called:
(Bohat se peptide linkages se bani amino acids ki lambi chains kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se peptide linkages se judi amino acids ki lambi chains polypeptide chains hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: are called polypeptide chains

blocks.prompt:
54 Proteins are organised into how many structural levels?
(Proteins kitne structural levels mein munazzam hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar levels primary, secondary, tertiary aur quaternary hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Proteins are organized into four structural levels

blocks.prompt:
55 The primary structure of a protein is:
(Protein ka primary structure kya hai?)

options.text: polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki khaas seedhi tarteeb
side chains ke asar se tah hona
do ya ziyada folded chains ka milna

blocks.explanation: Primary structure polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki khaas seedhi tarteeb hai (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: is the specific linear sequence of amino acids linked by peptide bonds

blocks.prompt:
56 Sickle cell anemia is caused by:
(Sickle cell anemia kis wajah se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sickle cell anemia: haemoglobin ke ghalat banne se red blood cells darranti (sickle) jaisi shakal le leti hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This is caused by abnormal formation of haemoglobin.

blocks.prompt:
57 In an α-helix, hydrogen bonds form:
(α-helix mein hydrogen bonds kahan bante hain?)

options.text: saath wale polypeptide strands ke darmiyan
aik hi polypeptide chain ke saath saath
sirf chain aur paani ke darmiyan

blocks.explanation: α-helix mein hydrogen bonds aik hi chain ke saath saath bante hain aur lipta hua spiral banta hai (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: In an α-helix, hydrogen bonds form along a single chain

blocks.prompt:
58 An example of a protein with an α-helix structure is:
(α-helix structure wale protein ki misaal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Keratin mein lipta hua α-helix hai; silk fibroin mein β-pleated sheets hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: creating a coiled, spiral structure (e.g., keratin)

blocks.prompt:
59 β-pleated sheets form when hydrogen bonds occur between adjacent polypeptide strands. An example is:
(β-pleated sheets saath wale polypeptide strands ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se bante hain. In ki misaal:)
blocks.explanation: β-pleated sheets tah shuda, sheet jaisi banawat dete hain, misaal silk fibroin (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: giving a folded, sheet-like structure (e.g., silk fibroin)

blocks.prompt:
60 Which of the following is NOT one of the side-chain interactions that form the tertiary structure of a protein?
(In mein se kaun si side-chain interaction protein ke tertiary structure mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary structure R-groups ki interactions se banta hai: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions aur disulphide bridges. Phosphodiester linkages nucleic acids mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: including hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions, and disulphide bridges

blocks.prompt:
61 The quaternary structure of a protein arises when:
(Protein ka quaternary structure kab banta hai?)

options.text: aik chain helix mein lipatti hai
do ya ziyada folded polypeptide chains (subunits) aapas mein milti hain
amino acids peptide bonds se judte hain

blocks.explanation: Quaternary structure: do ya ziyada folded chains (subunits) hydrogen bonds, ionic bridges, hydrophobic interactions aur kabhi disulphide bonds se milti hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: arises when two or more folded polypeptide chains (subunits) associate

blocks.prompt:
62 Which of the following is a fibrous protein?
(In mein se kaun sa fibrous protein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Collagen, keratin aur myosin fibrous proteins hain; enzymes aur hormones globular hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: collagen (connective tissue), keratin (hair, nails, skin), and myosin (muscle)

blocks.prompt:
63 Fibrous proteins are generally:
(Fibrous proteins aam tor par kaise hote hain?)

options.text: paani mein na-hal, mazboot aur mustahkam
paani mein hal aur aasani se denature
ziyada tar enzymes ke tor par

blocks.explanation: Fibrous proteins na-hal, mazboot aur mustahkam hain, is liye structural polymers ka kaam karte hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: These proteins are generally insoluble in water, mechanically strong, and stable.

blocks.prompt:
64 A protein whose whole molecule is spherical or ovoid is called a:
(Jis protein ka poora molecule gol ya anday jaisa ho use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gol ya anday jaise protein molecules globular proteins hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: If the shape of the whole protein molecule is spherical or ovoid

blocks.prompt:
65 The hardening of egg white on heating, as hydrogen bonds between chains are disrupted, is called:
(Garam karne par anday ki safedi ka sakht hona, jab chains ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds toot jayen, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garmi hydrogen bonding tod deti hai aur chains khul jati hain: isay denaturing kehte hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This is called denaturing of proteins.

blocks.prompt:
66 Milk protein casein coagulates on adding some lemon juice because:
(Thoda lemon juice daalne par doodh ka protein casein kyun jam jata hai?)

options.text: lemon juice is mein sugar daalta hai
yeh glucose mein hydrolyse ho jata hai
pH ki tabdeeli use denature kar deti hai
temperature 100 °C se oopar chala jata hai

blocks.explanation: Globular proteins pH ke liye hassas hain; lemon juice pH badal deta hai aur casein denature ho kar jam jata hai (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: the milk protein casein is coagulated when the pH of the solution is changed

blocks.prompt:
67 Enzymes and hormones are mostly:
(Enzymes aur hormones ziyada tar kis qisam ke proteins hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada tar kaam karne wale (functional) proteins jaise enzymes, hormones aur nutrients globular hain (27.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Most worker proteins (functional proteins), such as enzymes, hormones, and nutrients are globular proteins.

blocks.prompt:
68 Insulin, produced by the pancreas, is an example of a:
(Pancreas ka banaya hua insulin kis qisam ke protein ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hormonal proteins jismani activities ko control karte hain; insulin khoon se glucose ko cells mein le jane ko control karta hai (27.2.2).

book_ref.quote: An example is insulin, which is produced by pancreas

blocks.prompt:
69 Ferritin is a storage protein that stores:
(Ferritin storage protein kya jama karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ferritin kuch bacteria aur paudon o janwaron ke tissues mein hota hai aur iron jama karta hai (27.2.2).

book_ref.quote: in plant and animal tissues, where it stores iron

blocks.prompt:
70 The most abundant proteins in a vertebrate body are:
(Reedh ki haddi wale janwar ke jism mein sab se ziyada kaun se proteins hain?)
blocks.explanation: Structural proteins (keratin, fibrin, collagen) vertebrate jism mein sab se ziyada hain (27.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Structural Proteins are most abundant proteins in a vertebrate body.

blocks.prompt:
